independenceMethod: The same AI separately reopened and hash-checked the five official records, rederived academic progression from the adopted OER and reconsidered workbook evidence before checking the frozen record.
findings: The standard 180 EC route has 60 EC in each of years one and two, 18 EC of taught third-year requirements, a 12 EC thesis and 30 EC of electives. The year-three appendix expressly marks Comedy additional. Post-first-year exams normally require positive binding advice; the thesis needs all first- and second-year courses. The two source-language sequences advance from reading and prose to linguistics, independent translation and genre-specific research. UCR offers substantive comparative epic and myth, rhetorical analysis, Greek material culture and a direct case in Athenian democracy. The remaining advanced studies offer valuable general literary criticism, cultural reception and philosophy. The historical research seminar uses American evidence. None of the three related academic directions forms a sustained sequence in analysing original Greek and Latin texts and their transmission. A feasible schedule is documented internally. The partial overlaps and the absence of a full comparable UCR path are accurately described, and all 25 VU curriculum components and both specific notes were read.
